author: GavinNewsom
text:
Americans: we want healthcare, affordable groceries, and a living wage.

Trump Administration:

author: GavinNewsom
text: Turns out this genius was right the first time.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
The only person Donald Trump’s economy is working for is Donald Trump.

In 2025 alone he made billions through corrupt crypto schemes, settlements, and foreign real estate deals.

Meanwhile Americans can barely afford their groceries.

It’s sick.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Can’t wait for @seanhannity to report on this.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
NEW: Donald Trump’s own DHS agents admitted it UNDER OATH!

The president deliberately sent masked, heavily armed ICE agents to target our campaign kickoff on democracy.

They terrorized a community. A man selling strawberries was arrested for this disgusting political theater.

Absolutely disgraceful.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Americans are paying more for groceries, rent, and gas.

What’s President Trump doing? He and his grifting family are cashing in and getting richer.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
If SCOTUS caves to Trump and guts mail-in voting months before the midterms, it will throw our elections into chaos.

That’s exactly what MAGA wants. The more Americans vote, the harder it is for Trump to cling to power.

Show up. Vote. We can’t let them win.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
The SAVE Act is blatant voter suppression.

It makes voting harder for:
- Americans without passports
- Married women who changed their last names
- Military members and Americans overseas
- People with disabilities
- Seniors

Donald Trump is begging the Senate to pass it so he can suppress YOUR vote.

Don't let him rig our elections. Show up this November.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Trump is cracking jokes about natural disasters while American families are still waiting for the disaster recovery dollars he promised.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
The corrupt Trump administration has just admitted to withholding taxpayer dollars from states based on how they voted.

Last I checked we were a democracy, not a dictatorship.

Where the hell is Congress?

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Even Fox News can't spin this. Americans are struggling with the rising costs of just about everything.

Donald Trump promised lower prices. Instead, you’re paying more while he's getting richer.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Joe Rogan is too chicken to have me on — so he and JD Vance spent three hours in their California Derangement Syndrome safe space.

How cute!

author: GavinNewsom
text: Donald Trump does not believe in free and fair elections.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
California has free, fair, and secure elections and we will fight for them.

Try us.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
This is a 25th Amendment moment. 

I just watched the ramblings of a mad king and what else can I say — the only thing missing was tin foil. 

Donald Trump is trying to rig our elections and we have to stop him.

Show up and VOTE this November.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Tonight, America watched the ramblings of a mad king.

Donald Trump’s address was not about the last election — it was THIS one.

Before a single vote has been cast, he’s already laying the groundwork to rig this election and convince YOU not to trust the results if they don’t go his way.

This is what authoritarians do. Don’t fall for it. 

Organize. Mobilize. SHOW UP and VOTE in November!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
It’s impossible to understate the criminality of Donald Trump’s grift. 

He is now LITERALLY selling early access to market-moving information. 

Where is the investigation?

And how are spineless Republicans okay with this?

Disgusting.
cnn.com/2026/07/16/business/…

author: GavinNewsom
text: A shock to no one, Donald Trump is unwilling to accept the results of an election he LOST years ago.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Tonight Donald Trump will confirm he is the gravest threat to our democracy. 

This isn’t the rule of law — it’s the Rule of Don. 

Do NOT bow to this mad king.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
The world just got its first trillionaire.

At the same time, millions of people are struggling to get by and a generation is falling behind their parents.

If that’s not a five-alarm fire, I don’t know what is.

author: GavinNewsom
text: The old bargain is broken. We MUST democratize our economy to save our democracy.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Donald Trump is the gravest threat to American democracy.

If you disagree with him, he tries to prosecute you.

If you beat him, he calls you illegitimate.

This is not normal in a democracy. 

From Georgia to California, we must stop him.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Last week, Trump REFUSED to sign affordable housing legislation, calling it “so unimportant.”

Today, I signed a bill to cut housing costs by up to $60,000 per home, expand homeownership, and build more affordable housing.

It’s called governing, Mr. President. Maybe try it.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Not enough grifting Eric?

author: GavinNewsom
text:
There is a movement building across our country to STOP Donald Trump and defeat MAGA. I just spent a few days on the ground in Nevada meeting with young people, labor leaders, elected officials, and organizers — and the energy is undeniable. People are SICK of Trump’s grift and are turning that energy into action. 

Register to vote. Organize. Volunteer. 

Let’s flip red to blue and take back the House this November!

author: GavinNewsom
text: Sorry JD and Marco. Our diversity is our strength and that’s what makes America so great.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Trump is subpoenaing journalists for exposing his Qatari plane scandal— his Air Fraud One — a private jet he’s spent hundreds of millions of YOUR tax dollars on. 

He is the most corrupt president in American history!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Deploys private police.
Seizes ballots.
Prosecutes his political enemies. 
Purges watchdogs.
SUBPOENAS THE FREE PRESS. 

If only there were a word for that.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Young Democrats across the country are on the front lines fighting for our progressive values. It was inspiring to meet with @YoungDemsNV as they organize to fight Trump and save our democracy. Because of young people like them, we’re going to win this November!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Can’t afford your rent or mortgage?

How selfish.

The President has a ballroom to build.

author: GavinNewsom
text: We must take back the House or we will lose this republic.

author: GavinNewsom
text: If a president can direct the DOJ to go after political opponents, no one is safe. That's an abuse of power. Period.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Translation: 

California made it illegal for Elon Musk to buy elections. 

And next, we’re going to make it a felony for Donald Trump to rig one. 

Watch out.

author: GavinNewsom
text: No president has used the office to make himself richer than Donald Trump.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Lorenzo Salgado Araujo was a husband and father who spent 35 years building a life in Houston.

ICE shot and killed him on his way to work.

His family deserves the truth. Every immigrant family deserves to live free from Donald Trump’s fear.

California stands with you.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Donald Trump is still REFUSING to release billions in fire disaster aid OWED to victims in California.

Now he's doing the same to Democratic-led states while fast-tracking Republican-led ones.

Americans deserve better than government by political retribution.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
For five decades, the @CAConservCorps has empowered young Californians to leave our state better than they found it.

Corpsmembers have protected California's natural beauty, answered the call in times of crisis, and helped build a more resilient state.

California is stronger because of every Corpsmember who's answered the call. Thank you for your service.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
One year ago today, Donald Trump turned MacArthur Park into a stage for political theater — deploying armed federal agents and troops to terrorize a community.

It was never about keeping people safe. It was about intimidation and an abuse of power designed to spread fear.

California will always protect our diverse communities and the spirit that defines the best of this state. We'll NEVER stop fighting for the dignity, rights, and freedom of all Californians.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Thank you @USMNT for the thrills, the joy, and the belief these last few weeks. 

It was an honor to host you in California — see you on the field in 2030!! Forever and always, go #TeamUSA!

author: GavinNewsom
text: MAGA is triggered that we’re stopping Trump and his election-stealing insurrectionist thugs.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Meanwhile, California's homicide rate just reached a historic LOW. Violent crime is DOWN. Property crime is DOWN.

The data doesn't lie. The states with the HIGHEST murder rates in America are overwhelmingly GOP-led.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Nearly a million people lost BILLIONS on Trump’s crypto scheme while a handful of insiders made a fortune.

This is corruption on a scale our country has never seen.

author: GavinNewsom
text: The right to vote is the core of our democracy. If we lose that, we lose everything.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
250 years ago, this country was founded on a radical idea that government answers to the people.

Today, that idea is under attack by a man who embodies the very tyranny our Founders rejected.

Let's honor the promise of America by defending our democracy.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Happy 250th, America. 🇺🇸

I love this country. Our freedoms, our values, and our core beliefs are always worth fighting for.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Democrats are WINNING across the country. It's why I'm optimistic about November.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Donald Trump is declining across every front, but the power he still wields is real, and dangerous. We must remain vigilant.

author: GavinNewsom
text:
News Fox News REFUSES to cover: 

Crime is DOWN across the board in California and we just recorded the LOWEST homicide rate in state history.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Congrats, @pweiser!!

author: GavinNewsom
text:
Trump’s financial disclosures showed exactly how his crypto play worked: 

He got richer. His crypto supporters got rug-pulled.

author: GavinNewsom
text: Donald Trump is the most corrupt president in American history.
